label: Comparativo
original: The film is not as good as the book.
explanation: Se invierte la comparación: si A no es tan bueno como B, entonces B es mejor que A.

label: Comparativo con intensificador
original: I expected the journey to be much longer.
explanation: Se invierte el adjetivo y se mantiene el intensificador 'much'.

label: Igualdad
original: Tom is fifteen and Ana is fifteen as well.
explanation: Igualdad con sustantivo: the same + sustantivo + as.

label: Superlativo
original: I have never eaten such a delicious meal.
gapped: This is ___ meal I have ever eaten.
explanation: 'Nunca comí algo tan rico' equivale al superlativo: the most + adjetivo largo.

label: In case
original: Take an umbrella because it might rain later.
explanation: 'in case' expresa precaución y va seguido de presente, nunca de 'will'.

label: Segundo condicional
original: I don't have a car, so I can't give you a lift.
gapped: I could give you a lift ___ a car.
explanation: Situación irreal en presente: segundo condicional, con past simple después de 'if'.

label: Tercer condicional negativo
original: Without your help, I would never have finished the project.
gapped: If you ___ helped me, I would never have finished the project.
explanation: 'Without your help' equivale a 'if you had not helped me'. Ojo: 'hadn't' cuenta como DOS palabras.

label: Tercer condicional
original: I didn't study hard enough, so I failed the exam.
gapped: If I ___ harder, I would have passed the exam.
explanation: Tercer condicional: la parte del 'if' va en past perfect.

label: Unless
original: If you don't leave now, you will miss the train.
gapped: You will miss the train ___ now.
explanation: 'unless' ya es negativo: significa 'if not'. Por eso el verbo va en afirmativo.

label: Not + adjetivo + enough
original: The box was too heavy for me to lift.
gapped: The box ___ for me to lift.
explanation: 'too heavy' se reformula con el adjetivo opuesto: not + light + enough.

label: The first time
original: I have never visited Rome before.
explanation: 'Nunca antes' equivale a 'es la primera vez que'.

label: Present perfect + for
original: He started working here five years ago.
explanation: Acción que sigue ocurriendo: present perfect + FOR + duración.

label: The last time
original: It is ages since I last saw him.
explanation: Estructura 'the last time + sujeto + pasado simple'.

label: Would you mind + gerundio
original: Would you please close the window?
explanation: Pedido cortés: 'Would you mind' + gerundio.

label: Present perfect + since
original: I last went to the cinema in March.
explanation: 'La última vez fue en marzo' equivale a 'no he ido desde marzo': present perfect negativo + since.

label: Such + sustantivo
original: The music was so loud that we could not talk.
gapped: It ___ music that we could not talk.
explanation: 'so' va con adjetivo solo; 'such' va con sustantivo (loud music).

label: Deducción negativa
original: I am sure that Ana did not take your keys.
explanation: Deducción negativa sobre el pasado: can't / couldn't + have + participio.

label: Deducción afirmativa
original: I'm certain that he forgot about the meeting.
explanation: Deducción sobre el pasado: must + have + participio.

label: Ausencia de obligación
original: It isn't necessary for you to book a table.
explanation: Falta de necesidad: 'don't need to' + infinitivo, o 'needn't' + infinitivo sin to.

label: Prohibición
original: Smoking is forbidden anywhere inside the building.
gapped: You ___ smoke anywhere inside the building.
explanation: Prohibición: be + not allowed + to + infinitivo.

label: Reproche sobre el pasado
original: It was a mistake to lend him so much money.
explanation: Crítica de una acción pasada: should + not + have + participio.

label: Pasiva continua
original: They are building a new hospital on the edge of town.
gapped: A new hospital ___ on the edge of town.
explanation: Presente continuo en pasiva: is/are + being + participio.

label: Pasiva con modal perfecto
original: I am certain that someone has taken my umbrella by mistake.
explanation: Deducción en pasado + pasiva: must + have + been + participio.

label: Pasiva impersonal
original: People say that he is extremely wealthy.
explanation: Estructura impersonal: sujeto + is said + to + infinitivo. Muy frecuente en el Part 4.

label: Pasiva con agente
original: A famous architect designed this building in 1930.
gapped: This building ___ a famous architect in 1930.
explanation: Pasiva en pasado simple. Como el agente importa, aparece con 'by'.

label: Pasiva en pasado
original: Someone stole my bicycle from outside the library last night.
gapped: My bicycle ___ from outside the library last night.
explanation: Activa → pasiva. El objeto ('my bicycle') pasa a sujeto y el verbo va a 'was' + participio.

label: Call off
original: The concert was cancelled because of the storm.
gapped: The concert ___ because of the storm.
explanation: 'call off' = cancelar. Acá además va en pasiva.

label: Give up + gerundio
original: She stopped smoking three years ago.
explanation: 'give up' = dejar (un hábito), y va seguido de gerundio.

label: Look after
original: Who takes care of your dog when you travel?
gapped: Who ___ your dog when you travel?
explanation: 'look after' = cuidar. Ojo con la -s: el sujeto es 'who' en tercera persona.

label: Put up with
original: I refuse to tolerate that kind of behaviour.
gapped: I am not prepared to ___ that kind of behaviour.
explanation: 'put up with' = tolerar. Es un phrasal de tres partes: se aprende entero.

label: Disculpa reportada
original: 'I'm sorry I broke your window,' said Leo.
explanation: apologise FOR + gerundio. Después de preposición siempre va -ing.

label: Orden negativa reportada
original: 'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard warned us.
gapped: The guard warned us ___ the paintings.
explanation: Órdenes negativas reportadas: verbo + objeto + NOT + to + infinitivo.

label: Estilo indirecto (present perfect)
original: 'I have never been to Japan,' said Marta.
gapped: Marta said that she ___ to Japan.
explanation: El present perfect retrocede a past perfect: have been → had been.

label: Estilo indirecto (futuro)
original: 'I'll call you tomorrow,' Ana told me.
gapped: Ana told me that she ___ the following day.
explanation: En estilo indirecto 'will' retrocede a 'would', y 'you' pasa a 'me'.

label: Sugerencia reportada
original: 'Why don't we travel by train?' said Tom.
explanation: 'suggest' NO lleva to + infinitivo. Va con gerundio o con '(that) we + verbo'.

label: Avoid + gerundio
original: She always tries not to arrive late.
explanation: 'avoid' siempre va seguido de gerundio.

label: Look forward to + gerundio
original: I am excited about seeing you next week.
explanation: En 'look forward to', el 'to' es preposición: le sigue gerundio, no infinitivo.

label: Succeed in + gerundio
original: He did not manage to finish the report on time.
explanation: 'succeed' va con IN + gerundio, no con to + infinitivo.

label: Wish + could
original: I am sorry that I cannot drive.
explanation: Deseo sobre una capacidad presente: wish + could + infinitivo sin to.

label: Wish + past perfect
original: I regret not telling her the truth.
explanation: Arrepentimiento sobre el pasado: wish + past perfect.
